About The College
Established in 1945 by the people of Tezpur, Darrang College was permanently affiliated to Gauhati University in 1953. With the motto of “Be a Jewel among men”, it has been uninterruptedly working for fruitful dissemination of knowledge to its pupils with the solemn aim of making them worthy citizens of the country. The claim has been vindicated by a large number of alumni glittering in the national and international arena.
The National Assessment and Accreditation Council of India (NAAC),UGC, in its Reaccreditation (3rd Cycle) has awarded the Institution the prestigious CGPA of 2.68 on a four point scale at „B+ Grade (valid from 27th March 2019 to 28th March, 2024).......
Read More
Darrang College, the premier educational institution of North bank of Assam has been serving the people of Assam and Northeast India since 1945. The College has been strictly adhering to its motto to excel in producing "Jewels among men". The College was started with Intermediate classes(PU) and later on it enormously grew to become a college with three Streams of Arts, Science and Commerce. The Post Graduate course in four subjects were introduced in recent years. At present, it has more than 150 faculty members and about 5000 students. The college is affiliated to Gauhati University and has produced toppers in both UG and PG programmes and earned a good reputation in the region. The Higher Secondary result of the college has always added to the glory of the college. The infrastructure of the College has been continuously upgraded with modern facilities including ICT facilities for teaching learning activities and student centric facilities. Hostels for boys and girls are available inside the college campus. Sports facilities for students are also available with a playground for Football, Volleyball, Basketball, cricket and other outdoor sports, and an indoor stadium for Badminton and Table Tennis. There is an auditorium, conference and seminar halls. A huge library with INFLIBNET facility is catering to the needs of the students and faculties. The College website provides all the information about the College. All are welcome to our College website.
